g.text: Bulk RNA context after source-library qualification
68-hour in-vitro mouse CD4 T-cell cultures | untreated control versus DFMO
PCA of all nonconstant deposited genes on log₂(deposited-gene CPM + 1)
Lines connect paired cultures from the same source animal. Studies are analyzed separately; axes are not shared. No DEG-selected PCA or fate inference.
